Marcus / Eliza — reviewed. Draft answers below and I attached two artifacts (data-path-heatmap-telehealthplus.png, temp-failover-proposal-v2.pdf). I kept the legal language concise for the DPO.

1) Default transient egress window (operational failover):
- Our standard SLO for transient cross-region telemetry is <= 45 seconds. This covers token/KV cache sync and minimal routing state during an automated failover.
- Any permanent replication of logs or request bodies to non-EU regions will not occur without an explicit customer-configured opt-in; for mutual-action-plan scenarios, we use a documented uplift procedure.

2) Triggers and guardrails:
- Triggers: regional capacity exhaustion, regional control-plane outage, or explicit customer-requested failover for maintenance.
- Guardrails: encryption-at-rest in all regions, per-tenant key separation (KMS scopes), and automatic rollback if integrity checks fail within 5 minutes.

3) Validation run scope and redaction:
- Scope: one-week smoke validation (single-day live validation + logs collected for 48h).
- Redaction: we will mask PII in validation logs and avoid storing full request payloads outside the EU; only request metadata and diagnostic traces (trace ids, latency histograms) are included.

Attachments included: data-path-heatmap-telehealthplus.png (visual routing) and temp-failover-proposal-v2.pdf (one-page runbook + checklist).

Next steps I propose: TeleHealth to confirm the dates for the validation run (we're tentatively holding 2026-04-08 for the live test). If that works, we'll produce an attestation email you can include in your April 13 review.

Best,

Eliza — quick answers inline and attaching the Drive folder with supporting artifacts.

> 1) 45s window applies to automated failovers only?
Yes — the 45s window we quoted is for automated, system-initiated transient synchronization (routing metadata/KV cache). Any operator-driven cross-region recovery that requires more time will be scheduled and announced; in those cases we provide at least 1 hour notice and explicit approval flows. You will receive both webhook notifications (configurable endpoint) and an email to the security contact list we have on file.

> 2) short list of diagnostic fields you'll collect
We will collect: request_id, timestamp, source_region, target_region, latency_ms, routing_step_ids, cache_hit_flag, operator_event_id (if any), and anonymized trace sample ids. We will not include request payloads or decrypted content. Full list in the Drive link.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bRwin-telehealth-evidence

If this meets your needs I'll mark the validation run as confirmed for 2026-04-08 and prepare a short attestation email you can use with your DPO.
